entities.name: Branko
entities.description: A giant Azorius guard, over seven feet tall, who tries to keep Golgari prisoners in check during the Detention Compound riot and loses his ear to a gorgon.

entities.name: Gebris
entities.description: A mean-spirited teenage novice Azorius guard who taunts and kicks a prisoner and urges moving the prisoners through the sunlit yard.

entities.name: Gorgon prisoner
entities.description: An emaciated, bound and blindfolded gorgon among the Golgari prisoners, who is freed during the riot and vanishes in flickering light.

entities.name: Zivan
entities.description: The Arbiter who ordered the Mass Arrest touted as the ultimate clean-up of the Golgari.

entities.name: Relov
entities.description: An Azorius Arbiter who signs applications without care, dismisses a complainant over a spelling error, and receives a letter from Javy.

entities.name: Javy
entities.description: A Boros investigator and one of Relov's oldest friends, who survived a beating a year ago and summons him with a cryptic note.

entities.name: Mr. Lapt
entities.description: A complainant seeking compensation after a tenement floor collapse killed his family members, whose application Relov puts at the bottom of the stack.

entities.name: Grand Arbiter Leonos
entities.description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter for whom a new statue is approved.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The law-bound guild whose Arresters raid Golgari territory and whose Arbiters rule on applications.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The guild of the Undercity whose arrested members revolt in the Detention Compound.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: The guild Javy serves as an investigator.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The guild whose enforcer pays Relov and which is rumored to have wanted Javy and her partner silenced.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The guild whose children the Failsafe Initiative rescued.

entities.name: Failsafe Initiative
entities.description: A now-defunct joint Azorius-Boros program that rescued children and placed them in guild academies.

entities.name: Azorius Detention Compound
entities.description: The Azorius prison where the Golgari prisoners are held and revolt.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius guildhall seat where Relov works.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the guilds operate.

entities.name: Golgari riot at the Detention Compound
entities.description: A Mass Arrest of Golgari that turns into a revolt inside the Detention Compound.

events.summary: Branko guards kneeling Golgari prisoners in the basement corridor of the Detention Compound while the first floor is lost to a revolt.
events.quote: some of the Golgari overwhelmed their captors and gained control of the first floor.

events.summary: Gebris taunts a Golgari prisoner and presses his boot to the man's face, provoking the prisoners to hiss and growl.
events.quote: Gebris took the toe of his boot and shoved it against the man's face

events.summary: Gebris blames the Golgari for planning the raid, and Branko agrees to move the prisoners through the sunlit exercise yard to the South Block pens.
events.quote: "Let's take them through the exercise yard," Gebris urged.

events.summary: The prisoners surround Branko and free the gorgon to use her as a weapon.
events.quote: They were going to use her as a weapon.

events.summary: Branko fights off the prisoners, then closes his eyes and drags the gorgon into the sunlit yard.
events.quote: Closing his eyes, he charged at the gorgon.

events.summary: The gorgon tears at Branko's ear, the prisoners run free, and the guards lose control.
events.quote: Prisoners were running freely through the yard. They'd lost control.

events.summary: Light engulfs the injured gorgon, and she vanishes, leaving only an imprint in the sand.
Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and approving a new statue of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
events.quote: Learn to spell, Mr. Lapt, and stop wasting my precious time.

events.summary: Relov signs an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations when he sees the bribe amount.
events.quote: The request violated twelve statutes, but when Relov saw the pale pink number printed at the bottom, he signed without hesitation.

events.summary: Relov receives a cryptic letter from Javy asking him to come, after a year of silence since she and her partner were attacked.
events.quote: What is the culmination of a life of words? Buckets of blood. Come now.

relations.note: He is a guard in the Azorius Detention Compound.
relations.quote: batter down the walls of the Azorius Detention Compound

relations.note: He taunts and abuses the prisoners.
relations.quote: "Now, that's a rat face," Gebris taunted.

relations.quote: Arbiter Zivan had ordered the Mass Arrest

relations.note: She is one of his oldest friends.
